claim.value: If export-delay cause remains unresolved, sort requests alphabetically and compare whether latency improves.

target.text: Export requests show intermittent delay. Request labels are arbitrary identifiers independent of size, arrival order and service path. Alphabetical sorting here changes only the display of completed request records, not execution, routing, workload, or any suspected causal variable. The delay cause remains unresolved.

source_instrument.text: To diagnose a suspected causal variable, vary that variable in a controlled perturbation while keeping workload and measurement fixed, then compare latency. Rearranging a display without changing the causal system is not such a perturbation.

mapping.text: The analyst proposes a prospective fallback diagnostic rule. This rule does not report an observed improvement.

content_origin.rationale: Neither input supplies the proposed fallback rule; the mapping introduces it.

epistemic_function.rationale: The claim prescribes a prospective action if the cause remains unresolved. Sorting and comparing latency form the subordinate diagnostic procedure; no improvement is asserted.
